Alternatively, Sling offers a first-month discount to new users. The Thunder enter this matchup with a 57-16 record, but they are coming off a 119-109 loss against the Boston Celtics. In order to bounce back tonight, the Thunder will need a great performance from their star guard Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, He averages nearly 32 points per game, which leads the Oklahoma City offense.Notably, Gilgeous-Alexander also leads the team in assists this year. The Bulls have struggled this season, as they enter this matchup with a 29-43 record. In their last game, the Bulls lost 157-137 against the Philadelphia 76ers. In order to win tonight’s game, the Bulls will need to rely on their guard Josh Giddey. He leads the team in points and assists this season.
